faq.title: Frequently Inquired
faq.subtitle: Helpful guidance regarding acquisition, ordering through concierge, and product care.
faq.q1: How do I purchase ALUNE sunglasses?
faq.a1: ALUNE operates an intimate direct-concierge ordering model via WhatsApp. Simply click the purchase inquiry button on any piece to open a direct dialogue with our client team.
faq.q2: Are sunglasses authentic and original designs?
faq.a2: Yes. Every ALUNE edition is developed with dedicated optical standards and meticulous attention to proportion, finish, and structural poise.
faq.q3: Can I save favorites for later review?
faq.a3: Yes. Clicking the heart icon on any edition saves it directly to your browser's private wishlist without requiring an account.
faq.q4: How can I check availability for specific models?
faq.a4: You can inquire directly through our WhatsApp concierge with the model reference code for real-time availability.
